# Concrete — photo list

The catalogue below maps every editorial image and every product colourway to its actual file.
Missing files use the site's existing photo placeholder. Colour galleries are resolved by `photoSrc` in `src/lib/products.ts`.

**Status: 120 of 120 photos in place.** This file is generated by `npm run images:doc` — edit shot descriptions in `src/lib/products.ts` and `src/lib/editorial.ts`, not here.

## Rules for every photo

- **Format:** `.webp`, quality 80–85. Next.js resizes and serves the right size automatically.
- **Look:** cold, overcast daylight, desaturated, concrete textures. No warm filters, no neon.
- **No third-party brands.** No visible logos (HUF, Fnatic, Adidas etc.) on clothes, shoes or background — they were in the Figma draft and are removed here.
- **People:** this portfolio uses AI-generated fictional adult models; no real model releases or physical product photography are claimed.
- **Alt text** already lives in code; if a shot changes, update its line in `products.ts` / `editorial.ts` so the alt matches the new photo.

## Home page

Folder: `public/images/home/`

| | File | Alt text | What the photo should show |
|---|---|---|---|
| ✅ | `hero.webp` | Two models in Drop 01 hoodies standing in a brutalist concrete underpass, cold daylight | Wide landscape shot, 16:9 or wider (min 2400px). Two models in Arch and Void hoodies, full or 3/4 length, standing in a raw concrete underpass or stairwell. Overcast, cold light, desaturated. Keep the lower-left third calm for the headline, and keep the models near the centre so the crop still works on a tall phone screen. No logos from other brands anywhere in frame. |
| ✅ | `category-men.webp` | Male model in the olive Structure Hoodie against board-marked concrete | Portrait 4:5. Male model, waist-up, olive hoodie, board-marked concrete wall, soft side light. |
| ✅ | `category-women.webp` | Female model in the ash Plinth Hoodie on pale concrete steps | Portrait 4:5. Female model in the ash cropped hoodie sitting on pale concrete steps. |
| ✅ | `category-unisex.webp` | Two models side by side in matching graphite crewnecks | Portrait 4:5. Two models (any genders) in matching graphite crewnecks, same pose, neutral wall. |
| ✅ | `category-accessories.webp` | The black Concrete Cap resting on a concrete block | Portrait 4:5. Still life: black cap on a rough concrete block, hard side light, deep shadow. |
| ✅ | `fabric-400gsm.webp` | Extreme close-up of heavyweight brushed cotton fleece | Square 1:1. Macro shot of the brushed inside of the 400gsm fleece, folded edge, raking light that shows the texture. |
| ✅ | `capsule-olive.webp` | Model in the full olive capsule — hoodie and cargo pants — on a concrete rooftop | Portrait 4:5 (min 1600px tall). Full-length, model in the olive Structure Hoodie and olive Cargo Pants on a rooftop, city haze behind. |

## Products

Folder: `public/images/products/`. Portrait **4:5**, generated source resolution, kept without artificial upscaling. Cards and search use shot 1 in the first colour. PDP galleries and cart thumbnails use the selected colour.
